definition: A process in which a symbiont interferes with, inhibits or disrupts a cytoplasmic pattern recognition receptor signaling pathway. This is a mechanism by which the virus evades the host innate immune response.
label: symbiont-mediated suppression of cytoplasmic pattern recognition receptor signaling pathway
